heading: Pod Security Standards > Profile Details > Restricted
text:
**The _Restricted_ policy is aimed at enforcing current Pod hardening best practices, at the
expense of some compatibility.** It is targeted at operators and developers of security-critical
applications, as well as lower-trust users. The following listed controls should be
enforced/disallowed:

In this table, wildcards (`*`) indicate all elements in a list. For example,
`spec.containers[*].securityContext` refers to the Security Context object for _all defined
containers_. If any of the listed containers fails to meet the requirements, the entire pod will
fail validation.

heading: Pod Security Admission > Pod Security levels
text:
Pod Security admission places requirements on a Pod's [Security
Context](/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/security-context/) and other related fields according
to the three levels defined by the [Pod Security
Standards](/docs/concepts/security/pod-security-standards): `privileged`, `baseline`, and
`restricted`. Refer to the [Pod Security Standards](/docs/concepts/security/pod-security-standards)
page for an in-depth look at those requirements.

heading: Pod Security Standards > Profile Details > Baseline
text:
**The _Baseline_ policy is aimed at ease of adoption for common containerized workloads while
preventing known privilege escalations.** This policy is targeted at application operators and
developers of non-critical applications. The following listed controls should be
enforced/disallowed:

In this table, wildcards (`*`) indicate all elements in a list. For example,
`spec.containers[*].securityContext` refers to the Security Context object for _all defined
containers_. If any of the listed containers fails to meet the requirements, the entire pod will
fail validation.

• spec.ephemeralContainers[*].securityContext.seccompProfile.type

    • Allowed Values

    • RuntimeDefault
    • Localhost
    The container fields may be undefined/nil if the pod-level spec.securityContext.seccompProfile.type field is set appropriately. Conversely, the pod-level field may be undefined/nil if _all_ container- level fields are set. Capabilities (v1.22+)

heading: Advanced Pod Configuration > Pod and container level security context configuration
text: The `Security context` field in the Pod specification provides granular control over security settings for Pods and containers.

heading: Configure a Security Context for a Pod or Container > Set the security context for a Pod
text:
To specify security settings for a Pod, include the `securityContext` field
in the Pod specification. The `securityContext` field is a
[PodSecurityContext](/docs/reference/generated/kubernetes-api//#podsecuritycontext-v1-core) object.
The security settings that you specify for a Pod apply to all Containers in the Pod.

heading: Security Checklist > Pod security
text:
Pod Security admission `restricted` policy, the most restrictive policy of the
[Pod Security Standards](/docs/concepts/security/pod-security-standards/) set,
[can operate in several modes](/docs/concepts/security/pod-security-admission/#pod-security-admission-labels-for-namespaces),
`warn`, `audit` or `enforce` to gradually apply the most appropriate
[security context](/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/security-context/)
according to security best practices. Nevertheless, pods'
[security context](/docs/tasks/configure-pod-container/security-context/)
should be separately investigated to limit the privileges and access pods may
have on top of the predefined security standards, for specific use cases.

heading: Advanced Pod Configuration > Pod and container level security context configuration > Container-level security context
text:
You can specify the security context just for a specific container.
Here's an example:

#### Example Pod {#container-level-security-context-example}

apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: security-context-demo-2
spec:
  containers:
  - name: sec-ctx-demo-2
    image: gcr.io/google-samples/node-hello:1.0
    securityContext:
      allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
      runAsNonRoot: true
      runAsUser: 1000
      capabilities:
        drop:
        - ALL
      seccompProfile:
        type: RuntimeDefault
